title: NoteStore adapter over the venue kv
spec: Add src/venue/note-store.ts: venueNoteStore(transport, base): NoteStore (tclk's interface: get → value|null, set → won boolean). get uses GET /kv/<ns>/<key>, strips the banner, 404 → null. set uses the world-writable POST lane the paper rail needs: since Transport is GET-only, extend the HttpRequest type with an optional method "POST" and body in src/venue/types.ts (backwards compatible), send { value } as JSON with ?if_absent=1 or ?if=<expected>; 409 → false, other non-2xx throws.
done: PaperRail over venueNoteStore passes the rail contract suite against a recorded kv fixture, including a lost CAS.
